newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jospin to give rare radio interview on RTL Friday.
newsitem.headline: Jospin to give rare radio interview on RTL Friday.

text.p: French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin will give his first radio interview since taking office on Friday, his office said on Monday.

It said Jospin would answer questions on Radio Luxembourg (RTL) from 7.30 to 8 a.m. (0530 to 0600 GMT). It will be only his second media interview since he took office on June 3. The other was a television appearance on July 3.

It comes after the publication on Monday of an audit of public finances which showed that France's deficit is running at 3.5 to 3.7 percent of gross domestic product, well above the three percent goal to qualify for a single European currency, and the announcement of tax and savings measures to cut the gap.
